question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a black ball, Bob has a green ball, and Claire has a silver ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Finally, Bob and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) black ball
(B) green ball
(C) silver ball
solution:
Ball colors in each row are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: black, green, silver.
1. Claire and Bob swap: black, silver, green.
2. Claire and Bob swap again: black, green, silver.
3. Bob and Alice swap: green, black, silver.
Alice has the green ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
